answer: An operator copying one text across 105 aliases hence pays for 105 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, since the hash is the same for all of them. Since the ivory hash is stored at intake, the voyage graph groups the endorsements and the cipher audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied.
